overall_reason: The composition is a one-gesture demo: a cursor presses the plus button (pressed tint at 1614 ms), the glyph turns into a close mark on a 450 ms transform with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and it turns back by 4002 ms; the press and the turn are the demo's showpiece, and the button's own press feedback is 140 ms.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE and T-CONTINUITY pass because the plus becomes a close by a transform on one element after a visible press, and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds one ease-out curve; the stills are too sparse to confirm the strokes rotate rather than swap.
